name: 48' Flatbed (steel / combo)
notes: Deck height is the typical figure from industry guides (range ~58-62 in, varies with tires and suspension; one state bid spec caps it at 58 in loaded). Tare from Fontaine Velocity 48' steel dealer listings (11,680-11,840). 80,000 lb frame rating is distributed; Fontaine also quotes a 52,000 lb rating concentrated in 4 ft. Legal payload 48,000 is the common guide figure; the real number is 80,000 minus actual tractor and trailer tare.
sources: https://www.bidnetdirect.com/public/supplier/solicitations/statewide/22302274588/abstract — state bid spec, 48' flatbed, deck max 58 in loaded
https://www.lytx.com/blog/flatbed-truck-and-trailer-guide-dimensions-restrictions-and-more — flatbed 48-53 ft, max freight 48,000 lbs, legal height 8.5 ft
https://www.energy.gov/node/803656 — DOE Fact #620: typical Class 8 tractor ~17,000 lbs

name: 48' Flatbed (aluminum)
notes: Tare range 8,400-9,113 lbs (Fontaine Revolution dealer listings, depending on tarp system and options); Utility 4000AE (steel main beams, aluminum crossmembers) is ~8,800. Deck height is the guide value: no Fontaine or Utility listing found gave a flatbed deck height (one Hale sheet's 40.5 in figure looks like a drop-deck number, so I didn't use it). With the lighter tare, actual legal payload can be ~50,000+; 48,000 is the guide figure.
sources: https://truckertotrucker.com/new-2025-fontaine-qty-50-48x102-revolution-aluminum-flat-flatbed-trailer-haleyville-933767 — Revolution 48x102, empty ~8,875 lbs ±3%, 52,000 lb in 4 ft rating

name: 53' Flatbed (aluminum)
notes: Tare from Fontaine Revolution 53' listings: 8,900-10,184 lbs (9,442 / 10,047 / 10,172). 53' trailer length is not legal in every state (kingpin-to-axle limits, e.g. California).
sources: https://semitrailers.net/shop/2027-fontaine-revolution-52-53ft-aluminium/ — Revolution 53' aluminum, empty 9,442 lbs, 52,000 lb in 4 ft

name: 53' Flatbed (steel / combo)
notes: Tare from used Fontaine 53' steel-frame and aluminum-floor listings: 10,900-11,060 lbs. No official 53' Velocity steel flatbed sheet was found. All-steel units may weigh more.

name: 48' Step Deck (single drop)
notes: Standard layout is a 10' upper deck (~60 in high) and a 38' lower deck. Lower deck height ~40 in loaded (guide range 34-42 in). Tare 10,640-12,026 lbs (Hale base 10,640; Manac 10,800; Transcraft steel 12,026). Guides give payload as 44,000-48,000 lbs. Legal freight height on the lower deck is ~10 ft.
sources: https://otrucking.com/resources/guides/step-deck-weight-limits/ — payload 44,000-48,000 lbs depending on tractor weight

name: 53' Step Deck (single drop)
notes: Lower deck 42-43 ft (11' top / 42' bottom, or 10'/43'). Lower deck height 40-40.5 in loaded (Utility 4000AE drop: 40-1/4 in). Tare 10,280 (aluminum) to 12,235 (steel); a tri-axle steel unit is 14,300. Payload uses the low end of the 44,000-48,000 guide range because the trailer is heavier than a 48'.
sources: https://www.brucknertruck.com/inventory/2025-fontaine-53-alum-drop-base-63171 — 11' top / 42' bottom, 40.5 in loaded deck height, 10,280 lbs empty

name: Double Drop (fixed neck, 29' well)
notes: XL80-DD fixed gooseneck: 48' overall, 29' well, 18 in loaded well height, 40-ton (80,000) rating. Guides give well height 18-24 in and well length 25-29 ft. No tare weight found for a fixed-neck unit (the nearest is an XL80MFGA listing at ~19,496 lbs, a different model). Legal payload: ILS lists 45,000 max; other sources say ~40,000. Legal freight height ~11.5 ft.
sources: https://www.truckandtrailerguide.com/equipment/drop-deck-lowboy-trailers/2022-xl-specialized-XL80-DD-FIXED-GOOSENECK/85868089 — fixed gooseneck, 48', 102", 29' main deck, 18" loaded deck, 80,000 lb
https://www.ilscompany.com/trailer-dimensions/ — double drop max legal weight 45,000 lbs, legal height 11.5 ft (via search snippet; site not fetchable from this session)

name: RGN / Lowboy 2-axle (35-40 ton)
notes: Two weight classes. 35-ton Talbert 35CC: 24' deck (23'6" clear), 22 in loaded height, 14,580 lbs tare. 40-ton class: 29' well is common (Fontaine, Kaufman, XL); XL80HDE well is 28'7". Loaded deck height 18-22 in. The 19,500 lb tare for the 40-ton class is an estimate; it sits between the two published figures I found (14,580 for the 35-ton, ~21,080 for an XL80MDE). Guide payload is 42,000-44,000 (40,000 in a general lowboy guide).
sources: https://www.truckpaper.com/listing/for-sale/213524227/2026-talbert-35cc-lowboy-trailers-semi-trailers?print=1 — 35CC: 24' deck, 22" loaded deck height, est. empty 14,580 lbs, 2 axles
https://otrucking.com/resources/guides/rgn-trailer-weight-capacity/ — 2-axle RGN ~42,000-44,000 lbs legal payload; example 80,000-18,000 tractor-18,000 trailer

name: RGN 3-axle (55 ton)
notes: Well length 25'9"-27' (Trail King TK110HDG 25'9"-26'; Fontaine Magnitude 55H 25-27'; Talbert 55SA-LD 26'). Loaded deck height 20-24 in; low-deck versions go down to 18 in. Tare 22,510-26,380 lbs (Fontaine 55H ~22,780; Talbert ~23,140; used TK ~26,380). Unpermitted legal payload at 80,000 GVW was not published. Simple math gives roughly 37,000-40,000; otrucking quotes ~52,000-54,000 for a permitted 3-axle. A tri-axle heavy-haul tractor is common.
sources: https://trailerimages.haletrailer.com/inv/docs/trailer/A032859-1.pdf — Fontaine Magnitude 55H: ~25' clear deck, 22" loaded, ~22,780 lbs ±3%
https://trailerimages.haletrailer.com/inv/docs/trailer/A035523-1.pdf — Talbert 55SA: 20" loaded deck, est. empty 23,140, 3 axles

name: Multi-axle RGN 9-axle (jeep + trailer + booster, 65-75 ton)
notes: Typical layout: 3-axle jeep + 3-axle lowboy + 3-axle booster/flip axles, pulled by a tri-axle tractor (12 axles total). The 9 trailer axles include the jeep and booster. Etnyre 65-ton: trailer 28,160 + jeep 5,800 + booster 5,140 = 39,100 lbs; Blackhawk 65 deck 28' at 19.25 in. A 75-ton 9-axle example (TruckingInfo): 25,000 lb tractor, 150,000 lb typical load, 243,000 GCW, so its trailer group weighs about 68,000 (derived). Permitted payload is state-specific, so it is left null. Rated 130,000 = 65 ton; 75-ton units are rated 150,000.
sources: https://etnyre.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/L-RTN-LWT-14.pdf — Etnyre 65-ton empty weights: jeep 5,800, trailer 28,160, booster 5,140, total 39,100
https://www.truckinginfo.com/159304/75-ton-9-axle-lowboy-hauls-more-saves-money-for-equipment-dealer — 3-axle jeep + 3-axle lowboy + 3 flip axles; tractor 25,000; typical load 150,000; GCW 243,000

name: Multi-axle RGN 13-axle (e.g. XL MG 170)
notes: XL Specialized XL MG 170, a 13-axle West Coast trailer: 57,440 lbs including jeep and booster (can be configured to ~55,000); rated up to 170,000 lbs. 30' main deck with 15' T-deck; 26 in loaded main-deck height at 6 in ground clearance; 21' rear deck at 44 in. Combo axle count depends on the tractor, so it is left null (a tri-axle tractor gives 16). Permitted payload depends on the state: Michigan, for example, now caps at 11 axles / 164,000 GVW.
sources: https://www.forconstructionpros.com/trucks/trucks-accessories/equipment-trailers/product/10229074/xl-specialized-trailers-inc-xl-mg-170 — 13-axle, 57,440 lbs incl. jeep and booster, loads to 170,000; 30' main deck, 26" loaded deck height
https://www.house.mi.gov/HFA/PDF/Transportation/DOT_Subcmte_Testimony_TruckWeights_MI_10-3-17.pdf — MI history: 13 axles allowed 1942-67, now 11 axles / 164,000 lbs

name: Extendable Flatbed (stretch, 48'-80')
notes: Typically 48' closed, 80' extended (Fontaine XTP 4880 stops every 5'). Tare 16,060-21,850 lbs (Fontaine 16,060; Evans ~16,300; XL ~21,850). Rated 80,000 distributed but only 60,000 in 10 ft (Dorsey, XL); one rental unit is rated 64,100. No deck height found. Extended length requires permits.

name: Extendable Step Deck (stretch single drop)
notes: XL Specialized 48' single-drop extendable: 38' main deck extends to 62'10", 30 in loaded deck height. 53' units commonly stretch to 72' (Manac, Dorsey). Kalyn Siebert offers 48'/53' to 80' (40T/50T). 72 is used as the typical maximum. Low-profile 30 in decks; standard drop decks are ~40 in. No tare found. The 80,000 rating is assumed from the 40-ton class and should be checked per unit.
sources: https://www.truckpaper.com/listing/for-sale/230270663/2026-xl-specialized-48-ft-steel — 48' single drop extendable, 38' main deck to 62'10", 30" loaded deck height

name: Extendable Double Drop / Stretch RGN
notes: max_extended_length_ft is the extended WELL length, not overall length. XL80MDE: 29' well to 50'4", 20 in loaded, ~21,080 lbs, 80,000 distributed / 60,000 in 10' closed. Fontaine LXT40: 29'→50' well (48' trailer); the 53' LXT is 34'→60'. Trail King: 29'→49'4". XL80HDE: 28'7" closed to 49'11" (69'4" overall).
sources: https://truckandtrailerguide.com/equipment/drop-deck-lowboy-trailers/2025-xl-specialized-XL80-MDE/67381589 — XL80MDE main deck 29' to 50'4", 80,000 distributed / 60,000 in 10' closed

name: Perimeter Frame (lowbed, e.g. TK SA / expandable)
notes: Gooseneck perimeter frame (Trail King SA type): 37.5 in loaded deck height on 17.5 tires, 42 in on 22.5 tires; rated 80,000 uniform / 50,000 in 10 ft (TK80SA). Heavier models: TK110SA 100,000 / 70,000 in 16 ft; TK160 expanding 160,000 uniform. Expandable perimeter frames (12'-20' wide) sit much lower, ~12 in from the top of the crossmembers. Lengths and axle counts vary too much to give a single default.
sources: https://trailerimages.haletrailer.com/inv/docs/series/102810-102811-1.pdf — perimeter frame: 37.5" loaded (17.5 tires), 42" (22.5); 80,000 uniform / 50,000 in 10 ft
https://trailerimages.haletrailer.com/inv/docs/trailer/A032832 -1.pdf — TK160 expanding perimeter: 26" beam height, 160K uniform / 150K in 16'

name: Beam / Dual-lane Trailer (superload)
notes: Load is carried between two longitudinal beams, so cargo sits very low. Diamond Heavy Haul dual-lane units: 12 in, 14 in (325-ton) and 16 in deck heights (2008 trade press). Axle counts reach 24+ (Crane Rental Corp: 24-axle Trail King dual-lane, 360,000 lb transformer). Each move is engineered, so there are no standard defaults; set values per move.
sources: https://www.khl.com/news/dhh-adds-largest-trailer-to-fleet/1012198.article — Diamond Heavy Haul dual-lane, 12 in deck height

name: 53' Dry Van (reference)
notes: Interior height 110-1/4 in front / 111-1/4 in rear; interior width 101 in (Wabash DuraPlate sheet). Door opening is narrower (~98.5 in wide) and can be lower. Exterior is 102 in wide and 13'6" high. Tare ~11,600 (Utility 4000D-X listing) to 15,500 (guide range 13,500-15,500); a forum scale weight for a 2015 Wabash was 13,980. Rated 68,000 lb GVWR (DuraPlate HD).
sources: https://onewabash.com/docs/default-source/wabash-trailer-downloads/van-trailers-product-sheets/Dry-van-duraplate-cell-core-tech.pdf — interior height 110-1/4 front / 111-1/4 rear, width 101 in

https://transportation.revelationmachinery.com/listing/great-dane-cs1-champion-53-x-102-composite-dry-van-trailer-2022-air-ride-swing-doors-wood-floor-tandem-axle — Great Dane Champion: ~101 in wide, ~110-111 in high

name: Conestoga / Curtain-side 48'/53' (flatbed base)
notes: Flatbed-base interior height 98-99 in (dealer listings; guide range 96-102). Step-deck-base conestoga: ~96 in inside on the top deck, ~116 in on the bottom deck (guide 102-114). Tarp tracks cut usable width by 2-6 in; overall width grows to ~108 in. Aero says internal height is 3 in less than the system height. No tare found (base trailer plus the conestoga kit). Deck height is the flatbed guide value.
sources: https://www.aeroindustries.com/wp-content/uploads/Order-CON-Flatbed-Rev6_02Apr25.pdf — Aero Conestoga order form: adds ~6 in width (102→~108), internal height = system height minus 3 in
https://itagequipment.com/for-sale/2019-fontaine-53x102-curtain-side-trailer-13061816 — conestoga drop deck: 96 in top deck / 116 in bottom deck inside height
https://otrucking.com/resources/guides/conestoga-trailer-dimensions/ — interior height 96-102 in (flatbed), lower 102-114 in (step deck); tracks reduce width 2-6 in
